\caption{The capacity / Kaldor--Verdoorn door under the demand-only programme shock,

($\Delta P$, the GDP deflator; signed), the largest sectoral price deviation
($\max|\Delta p|$), employment ($\Delta L$) and household consumption ($\Delta W$),
all in percent against the reference continuation. The shaded $\delta = 0$ rows
(no door) reproduce Table~\ref{tab:results-matrix} (the elastic-supply panel at uniform
$\eta_{s,i} = 0.5$); the door creates no rent. The all-sector profile is in
Appendix~\ref{app:variants}. Generated from the
\texttt{pricing\_capacity\_rows-v1-*}, \texttt{pricing\_capacity-v2-*} and
\texttt{pricing\_mobile-v2-*} run manifests (OpenCGE v0.2.1); no number is
